BiblicalUsage: 1) to be silent, quiet, still, inactive; 1a) (Qal) to be silent, be still; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to be silent, exhibit silence; 1b2) to show inactivity, be inactive; 1b3) to make silent, make quiet, cause to be still
